Which camera should Hometown use?

The camera is the foundation of all town assets, UI/UX, and comfortable town interactions and editing. Every building sprite, footprint and touch target will be drawn to the one chosen here. Below, seven orthographic cameras look at the same town: today’s true isometric view and six others.

The numbers are recomputed live in the page with the same projection; the town is drawn with that projection too.

Touching, or only a corner?

Crafting buildings that touch along an edge form a production line; touching only at a corner does not count. Can a player tell the two apart at a glance? Two 2 × 2 buildings, 3.0 tall, drawn at each camera’s default zoom on the 412-wide phone.

What hides behind a building

A 3 × 3 building 4.4 tall, a 2 × 2 building 3.0 tall touching its back on the side where it hides most, and a critter behind them. Both buildings are solid boxes, as the page's numbers measure them; dashed lines trace what is hidden.
